narrative.intro: Axiom Space has $213M in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date. Axiom Space has 7 awards this fiscal year, with an average award size of $30.4M and year-over-year obligations up 62.7%. Fiscal-year obligations rose from $1.7M in FY21 to $213M in FY26, showing steady growth across the period listed. National Aeronautics and Space Administration is the top buyer, accounting for $213M in obligations, while Department of Defense accounts for $500. Guided Missile and Space Vehicle Manufacturing is the largest market for Axiom Space with $211M in obligations. The data cover contract obligations except where award-value figures are noted as total contract values in the largest-awards and expiring-contracts tables. Current-year totals are partial (fiscal year to date). This profile highlights where Axiom Space is winning federal work, how large those wins are on average, and which agencies and NAICS markets dominate the company’s federal activity.

sections.heading: How has Axiom Space's federal revenue trended over recent years?
sections.body: Obligations rose from $1.7M in FY21 to $48.4M in FY22, $75.2M in FY23, $134M in FY24, $131M in FY25, and $213M in FY26. The company’s FY2026 obligations are up 62.7% year over year. The average award size in FY2026 to date is $30.4M across 7 awards.

sections.heading: Who are Axiom Space's primary government customers and markets?
sections.body: National Aeronautics and Space Administration is the top buyer with $213M in obligations. Department of Defense shows $500 in obligations. Guided Missile and Space Vehicle Manufacturing is the largest market at $211M, followed by Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (except Nanotechnology and Biotechnology) at $1.7M.

faq.q: How much does Axiom Space make from federal contracts?
faq.a: Axiom Space has $213M in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date. Axiom Space recorded 7 awards this fiscal year, with an average award size of $30.4M and year-over-year obligations up 62.7%. Historical obligations show growth from $1.7M in FY21 to $213M in FY26.

faq.q: Which agencies buy from Axiom Space?
faq.a: National Aeronautics and Space Administration buys the most from Axiom Space, with $213M in obligations. Department of Defense also buys from Axiom Space, with $500 in obligations.

faq.q: What does Axiom Space sell to the government?
faq.a: Axiom Space sells primarily Guided Missile and Space Vehicle Manufacturing services, which account for $211M in obligations. Axiom Space also records work under Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (except Nanotechnology and Biotechnology) at $1.7M.
